Drama game of the week- Crazy alphabet
By admin
2 Oct 2023
0 Comments
Hello everyone!
We hope you’ve had a wonderful summer holiday, and we are excited to be back.
We’ve been very busy with school workshops, adult classes, and school shows, but now we are back with our very own content that you can use with your students in your classroom, which we hope you’ll enjoy!
Let us know how you find it, and how it works for you and your students.
The game that we have prepared for you today is called Crazy Alphabet. The game is fantastic for promoting improvisation and the ability to think on one’s feet. It helps players develop quick decision-making skills.
Here goes:
-Put your students in a circle
-Throw the first letter of the alphabet to your student on the left
-Let the students come up with their choice of words until the circle is complete (e.g. apple, antlers, etc)
Then move on to the next letters of the alphabet and complete another circle
In case your students are stuck, and no words come to their mind they can say “pass”
If they repeat a word that has already been said, then they will have to restart again from the letter A, but without repeating the words that have been previously used.
This game is challenging, keeps everyone on their toes, stimulates concentration, and instigates a few laughs.  It also works well for real or virtual classrooms.
We hope you’ll enjoy this game- see you next time!
Aurora xx
